enriched_activities.desc: Lie down in bed. Close eyes. Remain asleep in bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Turn over in bed. Continue sleeping until the alarm sounds at 06:45.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and showering
enriched_activities.desc: Turn off the alarm on the phone. Sit up on the bed. Stand up from the bed. Walk from Bedroom 2 to the Bathroom. Open the bathroom door. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the water heater. Turn on the tap. Cup hands under the water. Splash water on the face. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face dry. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Put down the toothbrush. Turn on the shower. Step under the water. Wash hair and body. Turn off the shower. Pick up the towel. Dry the body and hair. Turn off the water heater. Turn off the light. Open the door. Walk out of the Bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with Member 1, with tea; packing a light lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the Bathroom to the Kitchen. Greet Member 1. Open the refrigerator door. Take out bread, eggs, and vegetables. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water at the sink. Put the kettle on the base. Press the kettle switch to boil. Pick up the toaster. Place bread slices into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Break eggs into a bowl and whisk them. Turn on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Pour the eggs into the pan. Stir the eggs with a spatula. Turn off the induction cooker. Slide the eggs onto a plate. Take the toast out of the toaster. Carry the plates to the table. Sit down at the table with Member 1. Eat the eggs and toast. Pour boiled water into two cups with tea bags. Drink the tea. Stand up. Carry the plates and cups to the sink. Open the refrigerator. Take out a lunch box, salad, and fruit. Close the refrigerator. Put the salad and fruit into the lunch box. Close the lunch box lid. Pick up the lunch box. Place the lunch box into a bag. Pick up the bag. Say goodbye to Member 1. Walk out of the Kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing home workspace, turning on desk lamp and heater, checking emails and calendar for arts administration tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 2. Walk to the desk. Pull out the chair. Sit down on the chair. Press the desk lamp switch to turn it on. Adjust the lamp arm toward the desk. Press the space heater switch to turn it on. Adjust the heater dial to a medium setting. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button to start the computer. Press the monitor power button to turn it on. Pick up the phone. Unlock the phone. Open the email application. Scroll through the inbox. Tap and open new emails. Open the calendar application. Scroll through today's appointments. Type notes into the calendar. Put down the phone. Move the mouse. Click open the email browser window. Read emails. Type replies on the keyboard. Click send.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home on arts administration tasks at the computer, coordinating programs and writing reports
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at the desk facing the monitor. Place both hands on the keyboard. Type a program schedule document. Move the right hand to the mouse. Click to open a spreadsheet. Type budget figures into cells. Scroll down the spreadsheet. Open a report template file. Type paragraphs of the report. Press Ctrl+S to save the file. Pick up the phone. Tap to join an online meeting. Speak into the phone to Member 1's colleagues on the call. Take notes on paper with a pen. End the call. Put down the phone. Open the email application. Type a reply email to a partner organization. Click send. Open the calendar and update the event times. Stand up from the chair. Walk to the door and back. Sit down again on the chair. Continue typing. Adjust the desk lamp angle. Press the space heater switch to keep it running.

enriched_activities.activity: Heating and eating lunch with Member 1, with a break from screens
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair. Walk out of Bedroom 2. Walk to the Kitchen. Greet Member 1. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the lunch box. Close the refrigerator door. Open the lunch box lid. Place the lunch box into the microwave. Close the microwave door. Press the microwave start button. Wait for the timer beep. Open the microwave door. Take out the lunch box. Place it on the counter. Carry the lunch box to the table. Sit down at the table with Member 1. Eat the salad and fruit with a fork. Drink water. Talk with Member 1 about the morning's work. Stand up. Carry the lunch box to the sink. Rinse the lunch box. Place it on the drying rack.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short walk around the neighborhood for fresh air
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the entryway. Pick up a jacket from the hook. Put on the jacket. Put on shoes. Open the front door. Step outside. Close the front door. Walk along the sidewalk to the left. Walk past the neighboring buildings. Turn right at the corner. Continue walking along the street. Walk around the block. Turn right again. Walk back along the sidewalk. Reach the front door. Open the front door. Step inside. Close the front door. Take off the shoes. Take off the jacket. Hang the jacket on the hook.

enriched_activities.activity: Freelance illustration work at the computer and monitor, sketching and refining digital artwork for clients
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 2. Sit down on the chair at the desk. Press the monitor power button on. Pick up the stylus pen. Place the stylus on the drawing tablet. Open the illustration software. Create a new canvas file. Sketch outline strokes on the tablet with the stylus. Press the keyboard shortcut to add a new layer. Draw line art strokes. Press the keyboard shortcut to undo. Redraw the strokes. Select the fill tool. Click to fill color areas. Adjust the brush size slider with the mouse. Continue drawing on the tablet. Open the client reference image file. Compare it with the artwork on the monitor. Adjust the colors with the hue slider. Save the file with Ctrl+S. Export the file as an image. Open the email application. Attach the exported file. Type a message to the client. Click send. Stretch both arms. Stand up. Walk to the door and back. Sit down again. Resume drawing on the tablet.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a cup of tea and having a light afternoon snack with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair. Walk out of Bedroom 2. Walk to the Kitchen. Greet Member 1. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water at the sink. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch to boil. Open the cabinet door. Take out two cups and two tea bags. Place the tea bags into the cups. Close the cabinet door. Open the refrigerator door. Take out biscuits and a fruit. Close the refrigerator door. Place the biscuits and fruit on a plate. Pour boiled water into both cups. Carry the cups and plate to the table. Sit down at the table with Member 1. Sip the tea. Eat a biscuit. Talk with Member 1 about the day. Stand up. Carry the cups to the sink. Rinse the cups. Place the cups on the drying rack.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing household chores with Member 1: vacuuming and tidying the living room
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the Kitchen to the Living Room with Member 1. Walk to the corner of the room. Pick up the vacuum cleaner. Plug the vacuum cleaner cord into the wall socket. Press the power switch on. Push the vacuum cleaner across the floor. Pull the vacuum cleaner back. Push it under the sofa. Push it along the wall edge. Push it around the coffee table legs. Press the power switch off. Unplug the cord. Wrap the cord around the handle. Put the vacuum cleaner back in the corner. Pick up cushions from the sofa. Pat the cushions. Place the cushions back on the sofa. Pick up magazines from the coffee table. Stack the magazines in a pile. Carry the pile to the shelf. Place the pile on the shelf. Pick up cups from the coffee table. Carry the cups to the Kitchen. Walk back to the Living Room. Straighten the sofa cover with both hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the Kitchen with Member 1. Open the refrigerator door. Take out meat and vegetables. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Pick up a knife. Cut the vegetables on the cutting board. Place the vegetables into a bowl. Turn on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Add the meat to the pan. Stir the meat with a spatula. Add the vegetables to the pan. Stir the food. Add salt and sauce. Turn off the induction cooker. Slide the food onto plates. Carry the plates to the table. Sit down at the table with Member 1. Eat the dinner with chopsticks. Drink water. Talk with Member 1 about the evening plan.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair. Pick up the plates from the table. Carry the plates to the sink. Scrape food scraps into the bin. Rinse the plates under the tap. Put the plates into the dishwasher. Pick up the cups and chopsticks from the table. Carry them to the sink. Rinse the cups and chopsticks. Place them into the dishwasher rack. Close the dishwasher door. Press the dishwasher start button. Pick up a cloth. Wipe the table surface with the cloth. Wipe the counter surface. Rinse the cloth under the tap. Wring the cloth with both hands. Hang the cloth on the hook. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the Kitchen with Member 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV with Member 1 to unwind
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the Living Room with Member 1. Walk to the sofa. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the remote control from the coffee table. Press the power button to turn on the TV. Press the channel buttons to select a program. Place the remote control on the coffee table. Lean back on the sofa. Watch the TV screen. Reach for a cup of tea on the coffee table. Sip the tea. Place the cup back on the table. Talk with Member 1 about the program. Press the volume button on the remote control. Continue watching the TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on a personal illustration project at the desk under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the sofa. Walk out of the Living Room. Walk into Bedroom 2. Sit down on the chair at the desk. Press the desk lamp switch to turn it on. Adjust the lamp arm toward the desk. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button to start the computer. Pick up the stylus pen. Open the personal illustration file. Sketch strokes on the drawing tablet with the stylus. Press the keyboard shortcut to add a new layer. Draw line art strokes. Select the fill tool with the mouse. Click to fill color areas. Adjust the brush opacity slider. Continue drawing on the tablet. Press Ctrl+S to save the file. Turn the tablet page file. Sketch additional shapes.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and washing up before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair. Walk out of Bedroom 2. Walk to the Bathroom. Open the bathroom door. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the water heater. Turn on the tap. Cup hands under the water. Splash water on the face. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Put down the toothbrush. Turn on the shower. Step under the water. Wash the body and hair with soap. Turn off the shower. Pick up the towel. Dry the body and hair. Turn off the water heater. Turn off the light. Open the door. Walk out of the Bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and winding down for the night
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 2. Walk to the bed. Pull back the blanket. Sit down on the bed. Pick up a book from the nightstand. Open the book to the bookmark page. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the legs. Hold the book with both hands. Read the pages. Turn the page. Continue reading. Close the book. Place the book on the nightstand. Press the desk lamp switch to turn it off. Turn off the space heater. Put the phone on the nightstand. Turn off the phone screen. Pull the blanket up to the shoulders.
Lie down in bed. Close eyes. Remain asleep in bed. Turn over in bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Continue sleeping.
